menu.aiClipHint: Cut long videos into clips (new tab)

mobile.loginBody: Claim campaigns, post on your account, get paid per view.
mobile.onboardingBody: Add your name, username, 18+ confirmation, and accept the terms on the account page. Then come back to the app.
mobile.onboardingPending: Your profile isn't complete yet. Finish it on the account page.
mobile.connectWeb: Connect accounts through the platform's official login in the browser, then come back to the app.
mobile.withdrawWeb: Withdrawals, KYC, and bank accounts are handled on the secure account page.
mobile.pushDenied: Notification permission denied. Enable it in phone settings.
mobile.pushUnavailable: Phone notifications need a physical device and an app build (not Expo Go/web).
mobile.staleData: Couldn't load the latest data. Showing data from {when}.
mobile.accountWebNote: Personal data, KYC and bank accounts open on the secure account page (in-app browser).

widget.title: Clipper balance
widget.signIn: Sign in to see your balance

mobile.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign out: this device couldn't be released from your account. Check your connection and try again.

share.title: Send clip
share.body: Pick a campaign you claimed for this link.
share.emptyTitle: You haven't claimed a campaign yet
share.emptyBody: Claim a campaign, post the video, then share its link to Clipper again.
share.badBody: Share a video link (https://…) from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Threads, Facebook, or X.
share.pasteBody: Copy the video link from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Threads, Facebook or X, then paste it here.
share.noMatch: None of your claimed campaigns accept {platform} yet. You can still pick one below; the link is checked again when you send it.

pwa.title: Add Clipper to your home screen
pwa.androidBody: Opens faster like an app and gets payout notifications.
pwa.iosBody: Tap Share in Safari, then choose Add to Home Screen.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Check your internet connection and try again. Your data is safe.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong or the campaign is no longer available.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.connectBody: So you can claim campaigns and your views are tracked automatically.
campaigns.emptyBody: New campaigns show up here. Connect more social accounts to see more of them.
campaigns.emptyFilteredBody: Try another keyword or loosen the filters.

claim.successBody: Post your clip before the claim expires, then submit its link here.

detail.sponsored: You must use the sponsored content / paid partnership label.
detail.clipperFee: A {pct}% platform fee is taken from Rupiah earnings when they become Available.

req.followers: At least {n} followers on the account you use
req.minViews: Earnings start once the clip passes {n} views
req.maxClips: Up to {n} clips per clipper ({used} used)

review.auto: Clips are checked automatically and tracked right away
review.manual: Clips are reviewed before views count

submit.title: Submit video
submit.description: Pick the video you posted after claiming this campaign.
submit.noAccountTitle: No account on this campaign’s platforms
submit.noAccountBody: Connect an account through the platform’s official page, then come back here.
submit.noVideos: No videos posted after your claim yet. Post one, then reload.
submit.missingHint: Edit the caption in the platform app until every tag is there, then reload the list.
submit.urlHelper: Still checked against the platform API: it must be a video from this account.
submit.successReview: Your video is reviewed before views count.

social.title: Social accounts
social.description: Connect through the platform’s official page. We never ask for your password.
social.noneEnabledBody: Platforms are rolling out gradually. Check back later.
social.privacy: Access tokens are stored encrypted and only used to read your video list and views.
social.pickPageBody: Your account manages more than one Page. Choose the Page you post clips from.

igGuide.title: Switch to a Creator account first
igGuide.body: Instagram only shares view data for Professional accounts. Switching is free and reversible.
igGuide.step1: Open your Instagram profile → ☰ menu → Settings and privacy.
igGuide.step2: Choose Account type and tools → Switch to professional account.
igGuide.step3: Pick Creator and finish the steps.
igGuide.step4: Come back here and reconnect Instagram.

youtubeCode.cta: No Google sign-in? Verify via channel description
youtubeCode.title: Verify YouTube channel
youtubeCode.description: Paste your channel link, put the code in your channel description, then verify. Views are read from public YouTube data.
youtubeCode.step1: Open YouTube Studio → Customization → Basic info.
youtubeCode.step2: Paste this code into the {handle} channel description, then Publish.
youtubeCode.step3: Come back and press Verify. You can remove the code once verified.
youtubeCode.limitNote: Country and traffic-source data are unavailable without Google sign-in.

tasks.title: My Tasks
tasks.submittedBody: Track its status here. Views update automatically.
tasks.emptyBody: Claim a campaign, post a clip on your account, then submit it here.

groupHint.validating: The video is being checked automatically.
groupHint.review: Waiting for a reviewer (up to 72 hours for brand reviews).
groupHint.tracking: Views are checked regularly (every 4 hours at first, then daily).
groupHint.rejected: See the reason. You can appeal once per submission.
groupHint.appeal: A moderator is reviewing your appeal.
groupHint.locked: The view window has ended. Earnings unlock after the hold period.

tasks.paused: Tracking is paused because account access expired. Reconnect so views keep counting.
tasks.flagged: On hold for a views quality check. Earnings are not lost during the check.
tasks.appealHint: Think it is a mistake? Appeal once.
tasks.appealUsed: The appeal for this submission has been used.

appeal.title: Submit an appeal
appeal.description: You can appeal only once per submission. Explain why your video follows the brief.
appeal.label: Appeal reason

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.pendingHint: Earned from views, not withdrawable yet
wallet.historyEmptyBody: Earnings show up here once views on your first clip are counted.
wallet.processingHint: Being delivered automatically. Usually takes a few minutes.
wallet.manualHint: Waiting for our team to process it (1–3 business days).
wallet.rewardEmptyBody: Non-cash rewards you claim (vouchers, diamonds, etc.) show up here.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.completeFirst: Complete KYC and add a payout account to withdraw.
withdraw.nameRule: The account holder name must match the name on your ID. Payout accounts are managed on the Account page.
withdraw.inactiveBody: Your account is suspended. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
withdraw.instantOff: Instant withdrawal is not available right now.

mode.code_pool: The voucher code appears right away in the Rewards tab.
mode.webhook: Delivered automatically to the destination account.
mode.manual_export: Processed by our team within 1–3 business days.

reward.recipientBody: {fields} are stored securely on the Account page and only shared with the brand with your consent.
reward.successBody: Track its status in the Rewards tab.
reward.emptyBody: Rewards like diamonds or vouchers show up here once the earnings are available.
reward.privacy: Addresses and phone numbers are never stored in this app.
reward.consentBody: The brand ships this reward to your address/phone, so it needs permission to share recipient data with the brand. Grant it again on the recipient data page.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Updates on claims, reviews and payouts show up here.

profile.title: Profile & Trust Score
profile.trustHint: Goes up with approved clips and a clean account; goes down with rejected clips and fraud. Recalculated nightly.

instant.title: Instant withdrawal (score ≥ {n})
instant.body: Withdraw any time without waiting for the weekly batch.

premium.title: Premium campaigns
premium.body: Some campaigns are only open above a certain score.

cap.title: Higher per-clip caps
cap.body: Brands' per-clip earning cap is multiplied by {pct}% for trusted clippers.

hold.title: Shorter hold period
hold.body: Earnings move from Pending to Available after {days} days (riskier platforms still hold longer).

profile.historyEmpty: Your score has not changed yet
profile.historyEmptyBody: Everyone starts at 50. Submit clips that follow the brief to raise it.
profile.appealNote: Score lowered by a sanction you think is wrong? Appeal each sanction once under Account sanctions; anything else through support.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.description: Your display name and photo appear on the leaderboard and to brands.
edit.photoHelper: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 1 MB.
edit.photoTooBig: The photo must be 1 MB or less.
edit.photoType: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WebP.
edit.uploadFailed: The photo failed to upload. Try again.
edit.name: Display name

appeal.title: Appeal this sanction
appeal.description: You can appeal each sanction once. Explain why it is wrong.
appeal.label: Reason

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Ranked by counted views from active clips.
leaderboard.emptyBody: Rankings appear once the first views are counted.
leaderboard.noCampaignBody: The per-campaign leaderboard appears after you submit a clip.

referral.title: Invite friends
referral.headline: Invite friends, earn a bonus
referral.body: Friends who sign up with your link and pass KYC earn you a bonus on their earnings — paid by the platform, never taken from your friend.
referral.shareText: Join Clipper: claim campaigns, post on your own account, get paid per view.
referral.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy it manually from the field above.
referral.bonusHint: Lands in your wallet as Pending → Available
referral.how1: Share your link. The code is kept for 30 days on your friend’s device.
referral.how2: Your friend signs up as a clipper and passes KYC.
referral.how3: During the bonus period you get a percentage of your friend’s available earnings.
referral.emptyBody: Share your link in groups or on social media.
referral.errorTitle: Your referral code is not ready yet

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsBody: Transactional emails (sign-in codes, KYC, payouts) are always sent.

push.title: Push notifications on this device
push.failed: Could not update notifications. Try again.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications yet. You still get in-app and email notifications.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone, push only works for the installed app: Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from your home screen.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Change it in site settings, or rely on in-app and email notifications.
push.devices: {n, plural, one {# device registered} other {# devices registered}}

settings.accountBody: KYC, payout accounts, security and personal data are managed on the Account page.

errors.page_ambiguous: Choose one Facebook Page to connect.
errors.no_page: This Facebook account does not manage a Page. Create one or use an account that manages a Page.

errors.permission: The platform denied access. Reconnect and approve every permission.
errors.not_video: This link is not a video.
